input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: AZ TURNHOUT VZW. Summary: Framework Agreement for the Supply, Installation and Commissioning of a Spect-Ct for the Nuclear Medicine Service. Description: Object of these deliveries: Framework agreement for the supply, installation and commissioning of a SPECT-CT for the nuclear medicine service. Explanation: AZ Turnhout wishes to purchase a minimum 16-slice diagnostic hybrid gamma camera (SPECT/CT) in the context of a replacement of one of the current SPECT-CTs. The purchase file includes the delivery, installation and connection of the device as well as takeover and disposal of the device to be replaced. Furthermore, the purchase is accompanied by concluding an all-in comprehensive maintenance contract. All necessary tests and statutory checks are at the expense of the tenderer. It is possible that AZ Turnhout will rely on this framework agreement if the second SPECT-CT needs to be replaced. AZ Herentals and HHZ Mol are also considering the purchase of a new SPECT-CT in the future. If these purchases are planned, they will probably take place in 2028-2029. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: EUROPEAN COMMISSION, DG EMPL - EMPLOYMENT, SOCIAL AFFAIRS AND INCLUSION. Summary: Production of Labour Market Policy (Lmp) Statistics and Maintenance of the Eu Labour Market Policy Statistical Database. Description: The “labour market policy (LMP) statistics” project is a data collection developed by the European Commission to monitor the implementation and development of targeted employment policies across the EU. LMP statistics have been used to monitor both active and passive interventions in the labour market and, in particular, relevant areas of the EU employment guidelines. The LMP database contains more than 20 000 interventions reported by EU Member States and Norway since 1997, specifically data on expenditure and participants broken down by various dimensions. The project concerns the overall production of labour market policy (LMP) statistics, i.e. data collection including methodological and harmonisation aspects as well as technical aspects related to the maintenance of the LMP database and LMP application (software) and its use. <br> Doc Title: Production of labour market policy (LMP) statistics and maintenance of the EU labour market policy statistical database <br> Contract Type: services. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: SKEYES. Summary: Implementation, Licensing, Support and Maintenance of Workforce Management Software. Description: The aim of this assignment is to replace the existing planning software and related applications - where possible - with a new workforce management software solution. In this assignment, 'workforce management' must be understood as the whole of processes and systems, aimed at: the optimal use of the available competent employees. It involves tailoring the supply of personnel to the work demand via a duty roster, in which the contractual conditions of each employee, the applicable Belgian and European laws and regulations and skeyes' internal regulations are complied with. It also includes monitoring working time performance and data flow to payroll processing. The agreement will be concluded for an initial time horizon of 10 years (including the implementation, hypercare, maintenance and support phases). The implementation will happen in phases. After the initial time horizon, skeyes will be able to extend the agreement, each time for a term of 12 months. Description: The CHR of Verviers, acting as a purchasing center for four Walloon hospitals, is launching a framework agreement for the supply of dialysis membranes for a period of 4 years. In addition the parcel includes support services, including: the coordination, installation and configuration of the infrastructure provided, training for users, technicians and administrators, and the maintenance of both the newly purchased and the existing multimedia infrastructure. Lot 2 Audiovisual support during events and meetings This lot concerns the provision of audiovisual support in the context of the organization of events and meetings in the buildings of the contracting authority. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: FLUXYS BELGIUM N.V.. Summary: Supply of Control Valves. Description: The purpose of the contract is the provision of 7 flanged (ASME B16.5) carbon steel control valves for use in natural gas pipeline transportation systems. The scope includes six (6) valves of 12” and one (1) valve of 16”, designed in accordance with IEC 60534 or ASME B16.10. All valves shall be delivered with EN 10204 type 3.1 material certificates. Suppliers shall also offer, as an option, EN 10204 type 3.2 certification, with the cost indicated separately in the bid. The valve curve shall be of linear or equal% type (Admissible valve types are axial valves, plug valves, globe valves and cage ball valves. Excluded valve types: Butterfly valves, choke flow valves, angle valves). Each valve shall be equipped with an electrical actuator. Preferred actuator brands are AUMA or Schiebel. Valves shall be configured as “fail as is” and comply with applicable ATEX directives. The actuator-valve assembly shall provide sufficient resolution to enable accurate flow control. Actuator step size must ensure proportional correlation between valve position and flow rate. <br> Doc Title: Supply of control valves <br> Contract Type: supplies. Published Date: 2025-10-27. Closing Date: 2025-12-12. Competition: ICB. Financier Name: Self Financed
